name: Grade 9 IIIT Summative: Digital Media
description: Ten core third-trimester words for the Grade 9 digital media vocabulary table.

words.definition: Science, technology, engineering, and math used to solve problems.
words.example: The STEM project combined sensors, data, and a digital media explanation.

words.definition: One tiny dot in a digital image or display.
words.example: One pixel became visible when the student zoomed in.

words.definition: The amount of detail in an image.
words.example: The higher resolution image looked sharper in the presentation.

words.definition: How many colors an image can store.
words.example: Increasing color depth allowed the image to show more color detail.

words.definition: A small piece of sound or data used for measurement.
words.example: The audio sample captured a short piece of the recorded sound.

words.definition: A device that collects light, sound, distance, or other data for a media project.
words.example: The sensor collected light data for the media project.

words.definition: How much storage a file uses.
words.example: The file size became smaller after the student compressed the image.

words.definition: How good or clear something is.
words.example: The video quality dropped when the file was compressed too much.

words.definition: Making a file smaller, sometimes with less quality.
words.example: Compression reduced the image file size before submission.

words.definition: Red, green, and blue colors used to make other colors.
words.example: The RGB values changed the color of the digital image.
